title: Practice 3: By means of: the instrument

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: People living in Moscow are called Muscovites.
exercises.why: Instrumental without с is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted. The word in the instrumental case will correspond to English "by means of…", "by the use of…": *Он открывает дверь ключом. Я пишу карандашом. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book.
